data.name: Google Calendar: Create Event
data.description: Create a new event in Google Calendar with title, start/end dates, and optional description and attendees.
data.instructions:
Create a new event on Google Calendar.

Schedule an event with a title, start/end times, and optional description and attendees.

**Inputs:**
- {title}: Event title/summary
- {start_date}: Start date — "yyyy-mm-dd" for all-day or RFC3339 "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss+00:00"
- {end_date}: End date — same format as start_date
- {description}: Event description (optional)
- {attendees}: Attendee email addresses (optional)

**Output:** {result} contains the created event details including the event ID.
